summary_en: TOYO Corporation updated its initiatives to realize management with awareness of capital cost and stock price. The company conducted analysis and evaluation of current status and reported improvement efforts as of November 2026.
title_en: Update on Initiatives to Realize Management with Awareness of Capital Cost and Stock Price
translation_en_brief: TOYO Corporation announced an update to its initiatives aimed at realizing management with awareness of capital cost and stock price. The company conducted a current status analysis and evaluation of its efforts and provided an update on improvement initiatives as of November 11, 2026. The update was disclosed to support the company's objective of achieving sustainable growth and enhancing corporate value over the medium to long term. Detailed information regarding the initiatives and their progress is provided in the attached document titled "Initiatives to Realize Management with Awareness of Capital Cost and Stock Price (2026 Update)." The company's focus on these metrics reflects its commitment to creating shareholder value while operating within appropriate capital cost parameters.
